summary: Backend Engineer with experience building scalable backend systems in enterprise and product-driven environments. Specialized in Golang, REST/gRPC APIs, and system design, with hands-on experience improving performance, scalability, and reliability of production systems. Strong background in translating business requirements into robust technical solutions.

bullets: Developed backend systems for promo, loyalty, subscription, gamification, and campaign features used in production.
Designed and implemented high-performance promo evaluation services using Golang and gRPC.
Improved system scalability and robustness through backend and database architecture enhancements.
Built critical promo capabilities such as auto-apply, pre-validation, and optimized promo listing.
Reduced latency and improved throughput to handle a large volume of concurrent active promotions.
Designed and developed a waste tracking product used by multiple tenants and field operation teams.
Built backend services using Golang and frontend applications using Next.js.
Implemented real-time notifications to ensure timely coordination between tenants and field teams.
Delivered a scalable, product-ready system aligned with operational workflows.

Implemented core business logic and data persistence for financial workflows with transactional consistency.
Improved reliability of user communication by implementing Firebase Cloud Messaging for real-time loan status notifications.
Optimized PostgreSQL queries to support growing transaction volume.
Contributed to backend systems for a travel platform supporting hotel and flight booking services.
Integrated multiple external travel service providers into a unified backend flow.
Improved backend stability and data consistency across service integrations in a multi-service environment.
Supported large-scale API gateway operations handling high-volume enterprise traffic.
Built automation tools using Golang to eliminate repetitive operational reporting, reducing manual effort and error rates.
